scoring_justification: Transition energy E cannot be fully recomputed from displacement alone; we compare reported E to paper gold with tolerance. Zero-crossing counts and max_deltaZ are recomputed/verified from raw displacement maps.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold transition energies from paper (E12=0.82391 eV/Å, E13=0.82552 eV/Å) and zero-crossing counts (5 and 1)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: JETP Letters 2014 paper, page 4 lines 'E_{λ1→λ1/2}=0.82391 эВ/Å' and 'E_{λ1→λ1/3}=0.82552 эВ/Å'; text describes 'пять знакопеременных волн' (5 sign-changing waves) and 'one clear sign change'.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Exact values transcribed from the English translation of the paper
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported headline quantities; using the exact published values ensures a faithful reproduction benchmark.

required.systems: array of objects, each with fields initial_condition (string), energy_E (number), max_deltaZ (number), num_zero_crossings_within_W (integer)

outputs.description: Agent-reported transition-region energies, maximum out-of-plane displacement, and zero-crossing counts for both initial conditions. The hidden checker recomputes these quantities from the displacement CSV files and verifies the reported values within tolerances.
Out-of-plane displacement ΔZ for atom k=1 (in nm) at every unit cell index (m,n) for the λ₁→λ₁/2 initial condition. The checker uses this file to recompute zero-crossings and transition energy.
Out-of-plane displacement ΔZ for atom k=1 (in nm) at every unit cell index (m,n) for the λ₁→λ₁/3 initial condition. The checker uses this file to recompute zero-crossings and transition energy.

output_contract.notes: The three scored outputs together capture the paper's main result: distinct metastable wrinklon configurations with similar transition-region energies but different zero-crossing counts. The checker recomputes energies and zero-crossings from the raw CSV data, ensuring fidelity.
